# vastdata_de_logs (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Query function/pipeline logs (includes both `vast-runtime` and `user` scopes).
# Optional `message` filtering supports postfixes: `__iexact`, `__icontains`, `__istartswith`.
data "vastdata_de_logs" "example" {
  tenant_name   = "de-lab"
  function_name = "my-function"
  limit         = 100
  order_by      = "desc"
}

output "logs" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_logs.example.data
}

output "logs_pagination" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_logs.example.pagination
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cursor` (String)
- `function_id` (String) Function ID associated with the returned telemetries
- `function_name` (String) Full name or regex pattern of the Function
- `include_deleted` (Boolean) Include deleted pipelines in the results
- `limit` (Number)
- `message` (String) Filter logs by message content. Supports postfix-based filtering: - No postfix or __iexact: exact match - __icontains: contains substring - __istartswith: starts with substring Example: "error__icontains" matches all messages containing "error"
- `min_severity` (String)
- `order_by` (String) Sort order - ascending (asc) or descending (desc)
- `pipeline_id` (String) Pipeline ID associated with returned telemetries
- `pipeline_name` (String) Full name or regex pattern of the Pipeline
- `resource_vrn` (String) The Resource's VRN
- `scope` (String)
- `severity` (String)
- `span_id` (String) ID of the Span assoicated with the telemetries
- `tenant_name` (String) Tenant name for Data Engine API queries. Required for cluster-admin auth; optional when the provider already authenticates as that tenant.
- `time_after` (Number) time since epoch for which logs should post after (inclusive)
- `time_before` (Number) time since epoch for which logs should post before (inclusive)
- `trace_id` (String) ID of the Trace assoicated with the telemetries

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `pagination` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pagination))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `guid` (String) Unique identifier of the logs
- `message` (String) Content of the Log Record
- `observed_timestamp` (Number) Time since epoch in micro sec for when the Log record was observed by Vast Telemetries Service
- `resource` (Attributes) Resource producing the telemetry, as in OTEL specification (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--resource))
- `scope` (String)
- `severity` (String) Log severity matching OTEL specification
- `span_id` (String) ID of the Span this Log is associated with
- `timestamp` (Number) Time in epoch in micro sec for when the Log record was produced
- `trace_id` (String) ID of the Trace this Log is associated with
